scope: Phase 1 source, tests, gate, and configuration; local review by implementing agent, not an independent security audit

runtime.expected: Simulated demo reaches ready_for_acceptance; no implicit acceptance

findings.issue: Adapter could mutate the same request object used for expected event identity
findings.fix: Pass a structured clone to adapter while retaining controller-owned expected identity
findings.verification: request-isolation-red.json: one reproduced failure; controller regression included in final gate

findings.issue: Vitest unpacked array graph fixtures; rejection tests did not exercise intended graphs
findings.fix: Wrap each graph in an object parameter
findings.verification: Strict types and 20 graph tests pass, including generated DAGs/cycles and limits

findings.issue: Coverage include still referenced gate-policy.mjs after implementation used .ts
findings.verification: coverage-summary.json includes gate-policy.ts with complete branch coverage

checked: External inputs use strict schemas with bounded identifiers, text, checks and event counts.
Task/attempt/worker identity and event sequence validated on every event.
Worker messages cannot create trusted verification receipts.
Snapshots and adapter requests are copied; private maps are not exposed.
No provider authentication, token copying, model calls, arbitrary shell task execution, or network listener.
Gate subprocesses use fixed argument arrays, shell:false, Windows hidden windows, timeouts and bounded output.
TLS certificate checking stayed enabled; OS trust used for managed certificate chain.
limitations: Adapters and verification callbacks remain trusted in-process code; hangs require Phase 2 process supervision.
This phase has no persistence or service authentication and is not a boundary for hostile local code.
Dependency audit found zero reported vulnerabilities at install time; this is not proof of absence.

changes: Removed unused destructuring bindings in task revision logic.
Replaced the test event helper with explicit identity fields.
Kept task logic pure and independent of adapters; controller holds orchestration state.
cleanup.validation: Final type, lint, format, test and runtime gate
